question: Which firms set or judged the firm-judged table (Problem Solving Innovation) at FID 2025, and would two Vietnamese food firms (for example a chay maker and a plant-milk maker) set and part-fund a semester-long protein product problem in 2027?
why_it_matters: This is the first kill test of candidate public good AML-C1: without firms that set problems, the format is an ordinary course.
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask the FID organisers at HUIT and VAFoST for the 2025 enterprise list; then ask two chay makers and one plant-milk maker whether they would set a problem.
owner_org_to_ask: HUIT Faculty of Food Science and Technology; VAFoST

question: Did any entry from the plant-based theme of FID season 5 (2023) lead to a product, a firm trial or a company?
why_it_matters: Shows whether Vietnamese contest entries convert into products, which is the outcome a challenge lab is meant to raise.
cheapest_way_to_close: Read the season 5 results (the plan PDF failed TLS verification on 15 Oct 2026) or ask the organisers.

question: Does any Vietnamese university teach a credit-bearing course or module with alternative-protein, meat-analogue or plant-protein ingredient content in 2026?
why_it_matters: Decides whether AML-C1 is new or an extension of an existing course.
cheapest_way_to_close: L6 syllabus inventory (detailed course outlines of HUIT, IUH, HUST, Can Tho University and Nong Lam University).
owner_org_to_ask: Food-technology faculties of HUIT, IUH, HUST, Can Tho University and Nong Lam University

question: Could a shared food-grade pilot line (T5) host a process-engineering teaching capstone, how many line-days a year would that use, and would a university pay for them?
why_it_matters: Teaching use would give T5 a steady anchor user and help its utilisation kill test; it also gives RM-09 a concrete design.
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask HUST and FIRI whether a capstone on a 50 to 300 L food-grade line is feasible and what they would pay per day.

question: Does the Alt: Meat Lab still run its own courses and partner projects after Spring 2024, and would it host a Vietnamese faculty visit or co-teach a module?
why_it_matters: A direct partner would lower the cost of starting AML-C1; the evidence suggests the lab's own activity slowed after 2024.
cheapest_way_to_close: Write to SCET's global programmes office.
